caption: The drawing depicts a prancing horse in profile, facing right, with all four legs off the ground. The horse is predominantly colored in shades of grey and white, with uneven and patchy coloration indicating weathered or chipped paint. Its mane and tail are shaded in brown, and the hooves are black. The horse is adorned with a decorative saddle area showing designs outlined in blue, red, green, and yellow, and there is a brown stirrup hanging on its near side. A bridle painted in greyish-black runs across the horse’s head and neck. To the right of the horse is a vertical strip of rectangular color swatches showing the colors brown, red, pink, yellow, blue, and white. Handwritten notes, in pencil and thin cursive, are scattered across the page, detailing observations and colors used in the drawing, and there are sketched lines and some annotations related to scale and color placement. The background is plain, uncolored paper.
title: Carousel Horse (Study)
